title: Creative Newtech Limited (NSE: CNL) — Business, Valuation and Portfolio Action
sector: Technology distribution and brand licensing — IT, consumer electronics, surveillance and enterprise networking in India
archetype: Thin-margin technology distributor with a high-margin Honeywell brand franchise, funded largely by supplier credit and re-rated on mix-shift expectations
entry_posture: NO_NEW_ALLOCATION; REJECTED because the probability-weighted 12-month value of ₹1,287.12 is 11.7% below the ₹1,458.40 close and the base case offers only 0.14:1 reward-to-risk even from the top of the ₹1,184.30–₹1,297.52 support band.
weinstein_stage: Stage 2 (extended, +21.3% above the 10-week EMA; LTASM stage II surveillance)
verdict_rule_summary: Reject new capital when the business is CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL, the probability-weighted value is below the price, and reward-to-risk from the top of support is below 1.5:1; re-underwrite at or below about ₹1,089 (the ₹1,184.30–₹1,297.52 watch zone alone does not reopen the verdict) or on proof that working-capital inflows are structural.
holding_rationale: Creative Newtech is not held in any account in the same-session positions ledger, so there are no shares to hold, trim or exit. The call for new capital is REJECTED and the alerts below are advisory re-underwrite triggers, not broker orders.

holding_alerts.trigger: Advisory alert on an unowned stock
holding_alerts.instruction: Do not open a CNL position at the ₹1,458.40 close (30.7x trailing attributable EPS, 5.46x book value). Any future interest should be expressed through cash equity only; the stock is not in the NSE F&O segment.

holding_alerts.trigger: Price at or below the re-underwrite level
holding_alerts.instruction: Re-underwrite the business and re-run the 1.5:1 test. At about ₹1,089 the ₹1,351.93 base case clears 1.5 times the risk to the ₹913.79 stop, but only if the funding-quality questions in Chapters 5 and 6 have not worsened.

Re-underwrite if net working capital sits between 52 and 55 days and cumulative nine-month operating cash flow is at least half of profit; treat a fall back toward 75 days or a negative nine-month operating cash flow as confirmation of the Bear case.
Read the renewal term, territory and minimum guarantee before any new work; a higher minimum guarantee or narrower scope lowers the base-case brand profit.

holding_alerts.trigger: Weekly close above the ₹1,550.20 high on volume above 1.5x the 30-day average
holding_alerts.instruction: Refresh the momentum read only; a breakout does not by itself change the REJECTED call, because the base-case value stays below the price.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal cash allocation unit under review (100% cash pool, because CNL is not held in any account)

destinations.rationale: AJMERA closed at ₹133.28, 0.8% above the top of its ₹124.51–₹132.17 support band; the existing position is already 4.06% of net worth and was not re-underwritten in this run.
destinations.entry_condition: Add only inside the support band while its uptrend holds and the existing position stays within its risk budget.

destinations.recommendation: 0% today; wait for a support retest before any staged allocation.
destinations.rationale: MANORAMA closed at ₹1,984.10, 1.4% above the top of its ₹1,869.54–₹1,957.58 support band, and the existing position is already 4.16% of net worth.
destinations.entry_condition: Revisit only inside the ₹1,869.54–₹1,957.58 band while its uptrend remains intact.

destinations.recommendation: 0% today; monitor the scale distributor peer without committing capital.
destinations.rationale: Redington (13.6x trailing earnings, 31% revenue growth) sits in Stage 3 below its 50-day average; our derived base value of ₹403.20 (14x forward EPS of ₹28.80) gives 0.82:1 at the ₹349.70 close, below the 1.5:1 hurdle.
destinations.entry_condition: Require a hold of the ₹289.79–₹298.61 support band with volume expansion on the turn, or a base value that clears 1.5:1.

destinations.recommendation: Retain the reviewed capital in cash or liquid treasury until a qualified candidate clears both the evidence and entry gates.
destinations.rationale: CNL is rejected for new capital on a negative probability-weighted return, and no shortlist or outside candidate cleared its own entry condition at this session's close.
destinations.entry_condition: Reassess when CNL clears the Q3 FY27 and Honeywell triggers, or when a shortlist name returns to its support band with an earned verdict.

primer: Creative Newtech is a Mumbai technology distributor whose revenue grew from ₹371 Cr in FY19 to ₹2,718 Cr in FY26, with a Honeywell licence earning about half of EBITDA. The profit is real, but operating cash flow was negative in seven of eight years, and about 84% of the ₹351 Cr H1 FY27 inflow was a net release of working capital that the CFO calls unsustainable. At ₹1,458.40 the stock trades at 30.7 times trailing earnings after a 176% rise since March, and our probability-weighted value of ₹1,287 is 11.7% lower. New capital is REJECTED, the holding action is NOT_HELD, and the reviewed capital stays in cash. We would be wrong if working-capital inflows prove structural and the Honeywell licence renews on current terms.
sizing_table_takeaway: A REJECTED verdict means zero new risk-unit allocation. The ₹1,184.30–₹1,297.52 support band and the ₹913.79 stop are monitoring references only, not live orders.
